## 21001 - 21006

#### 21001 TANK - Calculated GSV does not match given GSV (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="21002">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />21002 TANK – Capacity table not given for ticket period</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="21002">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets. This exception is generated for a tank ticket with an effective date that is not covered by the tank’s active capacity table data. In this scenario, calculation of total observed volume (TOV) will not take place for the ticket. To resolve the exception, capacity table data needs to be provided for the period, or a different capacity table must be selected.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="21003">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />21003 TANK – Construction material not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="21003">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved on a tank that does not have Construction Material set to one of the options available on the Main tab of the Tank Editor.

If the Use Steel Temperature Correction (CTS) for Calculations option on the Capacity Table editor is enabled, CTS (liquid) and CTS (vapor) will not be calculated.

If the Use Steel Pressure Correction (CPS) for Calculations option on the Capacity Table editor is enabled, Shell Pressure Correction will not be calculated.

To resolve the exception, the Construction Material field needs to be populated in the Tank Editor.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="21004">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />21004 TANK - Run splitting process failed (effective date collision)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="21004">

Generated when the splitting process fails due to the presence of a gauge ticket with the same effective date as the (unsplit) run ticket.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="21005">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />21005 TANK - Run splitting process failed (failed to obtain external ticket number)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="21005">

Generated when the custom external ticket numbering feature is in use and system was unable to retrieve a ticket number for the newly split record. The split will not occur when this happens.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="21006">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />21006 TANK – Capacity table not configured</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="21006">

This exception indicates that a capacity table has not been configured in the tank characteristic for the effective date of the ticket. Calculation of total observed volume (TOV) will not take place for the ticket. To resolve the exception, a capacity table must be set on the tank’s characteristic.

</div>

</div>
